$description: Machine-readable mirror of carousel-manifest.md. Numeric values for renderers. Companion: cantaloupe.design-contracts.json (validation), design-tokens.json (DTCG source). Orientation-coupled blocks (canvas, grid.page, grid.contentArea, header positions, footer positions, columns) live under orientations.{vertical|landscape}. The driver injects an `ACTIVE ORIENTATION` header into each agent's prompt; the agent picks the matching block and ignores the other.

logo.$description: Default header element (replaces the eyebrow tag). See top-level `branding.headerLogo` for asset path and styling rules.

tag.$description: Legacy eyebrow tag slot. Reserved for cover-only override copy (`A Short Essay` etc.). For non-cover plates the logo replaces the tag entirely.

columns.$description: Single-column content widths. The vertical canvas is too narrow for a two-column body — pick one of these widths and center, or hang a `narrow` column off the gutter.

logo.$description: Default header element (replaces the eyebrow tag). See top-level `branding.headerLogo` for asset path and styling rules.

tag.$description: Legacy eyebrow tag slot. Reserved for cover-only override copy. For non-cover plates the logo replaces the tag entirely.

columns.$description: Editorial two-column body for landscape. Title plates use the full hero band; body plates use bodyTwoCol; code stays single-column because code blocks should not split.

bodyTwoCol.$description: Two body columns of 720 px with a 96 px gutter (1536 px total). Center inside the 1664 px content area so the outer breathing on each side is 64 px.

branding.$description: Until theming lands (see `themingFutureWork`), every carousel uses happycampr brand identity. The implementation agent must include the header logo on every slide.
branding.themingFutureWork: Carousels will eventually support themes — selectable brand identities (e.g. agency clients, alternate happycampr themes, neutral/blank). Theming is OUT OF SCOPE for v0.x. The current assumption is hardcoded: every slide uses the happycampr full lockup. When theming lands, this `branding` block becomes per-theme, with the carousel row gaining a `theme` column the renderer/agents read.

headerLogo.$description: happycampr full lockup (marshmallow mark + 'happycampr' wordmark) in brand colours #F5F1E8 fill / #2B1810 stroke. Drives the header's top-left slot on every non-cover slide; on cover slides it sits at the same anchor and the cover's display title still owns the bottom of the canvas. See design/ambiguous.md §13.5.
headerLogo.perSlideCopyStrategy: The driver copies the asset into each slide's working directory at run start under the `perSlideFilename` name; the agent references it by filename only. This keeps the HTML portable: the slide folder is fully self-contained and the renderer's `file://` resolution does the rest.

minClearancePx.$description: Header chrome is exempt from the 40 px shape-to-rule contract — same exemption the eyebrow tag has always had. Logo bottom must clear the topRule by at least this many px.

grid.$description: Scale-invariant grid tokens — baselineSnap and the space scale are the same in both orientations. Per-orientation page margins and content boxes live under orientations.X.grid.

color.$note: happycampr four-colour palette. warning→graham (no amber), complement→burnt/ink (no mulberry), code-string→moss. Only graham+moss are chromatic. See design/ambiguous.md §13.1.

shapes.$description: Decorative-shape primitives. Default positions below are tuned for the vertical canvas; in landscape the agent must adapt positions to keep the safe-zones (40 px from rules, 32 px from text) while preserving the same compositional intent (e.g. circle-right still bleeds off the right edge, just at a different y).

circle-center.safeZone: Must clear 40 px from top rule

circle-right.safeZone: Bleed is intentional; must clear top rule by 40 px

bar-left.safeZone: Must be behind text, not touching

triangle-tr.safeZone: Must clear top rule by 80 px

square-tr.safeZone: Must clear top rule by 40 px

chart.$description: plate-chart engine config. Charts.css (pure CSS) styles a semantic <table> as a chart — no JS, no canvas, no inline-SVG charts. Machine mirror of carousel-manifest.md §12a; hard rules live in cantaloupe.design-contracts.json#chart.
chart.sizeNormalization: --size = value / axisMax, clamped 0..1; line and area cells additionally use --start (running baseline) + --size (segment)

plotBox.$description: The chart <table> bounding box must fit inside the active orientation's grid.contentArea, which is already inset 40 px from the top/bottom rules (so shape-to-rule is automatic). With a headline, the chart box starts >= headlineGapPx below the headline's last line.

chart.captionHandling: suppress (caption { display: none }) or restyle to the caption token; the slide headline is the chart title
